title: Backfill bee.evidence on patterns whose prose names a shipped enforcement
action: Walk docs/knowledge/patterns/*.md. Where the pattern prose explicitly names an enforcement that exists in the shipped tree (a hook denial, guard, doctor check, or test — verify the named artifact exists before annotating), add bee.evidence: wired (enforced at runtime) or exercised (a test covers it) plus bee.evidence_ref naming the artifact path or test name. Patterns without a verifiable named enforcement stay untouched (default present). Frontmatter edits must stay canonical (emitter round-trip clean — run bee knowledge check after edits; the vendored .bee/bin/bee needs building first, see worktree note). Depends on el-1.

truths: Every annotation cites an artifact verified to exist
No pattern annotated on prose alone
knowledge check stays clean (no not_canonical, no invalid_evidence_state)

trace.outcome: Backfilled bee.evidence on 5 patterns whose prose names a verified, shipped enforcement; knowledge check clean (0 not_canonical, 0 invalid_evidence_state introduced)
